mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair fentanyl metabolism and increase CNS depression risk; additive cardiotoxicity and respiratory depression.
action: Monitor renal function and electrolytes closely; adjust fentanyl dosing based on renal status; consider alternative antifungal if possible; monitor respiratory function and cardiac status.
